# CWE-798: AWS secret access key — 40-char base64 credential.
# wJalr... is the secret paired with the key ID; together they are full
# access. The rule flags 40-char secrets; ok is "changeme" or short.
# ruleid: detected-aws-secret-access-key
aws_secret_access_key = wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEFUCDlEKEY
# ruleid: detected-aws-secret-access-key
aws_secret_access_key = "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEFUCDlEKEY"
# ok: detected-aws-secret-access-key
aws_secret_access_key = "changeme"
# ok: detected-aws-secret-access-key
aws_secret_access_key = "short"
# ruleid: detected-aws-secret-access-key
aws_secret_access_key = aBCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz1234567890ABCD
# ruleid: detected-aws-secret-access-key
aws_secret_access_key = "ZyXwVuTsRqPoNmLkJiHgFeDcBa1234567890ABCD"
# ok: detected-aws-secret-access-key
aws_secret_access_key = "example_placeholder_xxxxxx"
